description: Generation-pinned GCS handoff for the final Sabine nomination-revision intraday overlay. The raw all-cycle OAC archive rebuilds the retained TransCameron and Jefferson Island revisions; the assembled research panel is the exact downstream factor contract; and the execution-window table is the exact processed trade-price contract used by the evaluator.

reproduction_levels.gcs_lineage_rebuild: Rebuild the two nomination revisions and their 20/60/120-gas-day causal z-scores from the raw all-cycle OAC archive, require exact parity with the assembled panel, validate the execution-window contract, and rerun the final evaluator.
reproduction_levels.v03_downstream_rebuild: Use the same pinned nomination inputs with either the checked-in V03 daily path or the strategy_daily.parquet produced by the V03 reproduction pipeline.

limitations: The Sabine archive is a retrospectively assembled all-cycle archive. Native EBB posting timestamps are retained, but this is not an untouched prospective capture.
When more than one complete EBB snapshot exists for the same gas day and cycle, the raw rebuild keeps the snapshot with the latest native posting timestamp before aggregating point quantities.
Scheduled quantity is a commercial nomination, not a metered physical-flow observation.

The execution-window parquet is the exact processed contract derived from controlled NYMEX outright trade data. Raw tick files are not redistributed by this handoff; the manifest therefore reproduces and audits the retained VWAP inputs but does not independently reconstruct them from raw trades.
The evaluator remains a historical research overlay outside formal model V03 and is not a formal V04.

artifacts.role: Raw all-cycle Sabine OAC archive used to rebuild the retained LNG and storage nomination revisions and causal standardization histories.
Exact assembled downstream factor and execution-alignment contract used by the final evaluator and retained as the parity target for the raw OAC rebuild.
Exact processed posting-plus-5-to-30-minute and settlement-window VWAP contract derived from controlled NYMEX outright trade data.
